lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Exit 13. This is it.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Night auditor. Ten to six. Gas station, motel, the whole thing.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Just keep the lights on, the coffee hot, and the register balanced.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: I can do this. It's just a job.
[Clock in at the time clock to begin your shift]
[A car pulls into the forecourt]

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: First customer of the night. Here we go.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: I'd like Room 4, please. I always stay in Room 4.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Room 4 is... it's not available. It's been closed.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: Closed? Since when? I was just there.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: I... let me find you another room.
How do you respond?

choices.text: Ask when they last stayed here

lines.speaker: Radio
lines.text: ...exit... thirteen... do you copy...

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: What the... that's not a station frequency.

lines.speaker: Radio
lines.text: ...she's there... at the desk... tell her to check room four...

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Who is this? This is a private channel.

lines.speaker: Radio
lines.text: ...static...

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Great. Just great.

lines.speaker: Deputy Hale
lines.text: Evening. Deputy Hale, county sheriff's office.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Can I help you, Deputy?

lines.speaker: Deputy Hale
lines.text: Routine check. We've had some calls about this location. Unusual activity.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: What kind of activity?

lines.speaker: Deputy Hale
lines.text: People reporting guests who don't check out. Cars that appear and vanish. You seen anything like that?
What do you tell the deputy?

choices.text: Ask him about the Mile 87 pileup

lines.speaker: Phone
lines.text: [Ring... ring...]

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Exit 13, night audit.

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.text: It's me. I know what you've been doing.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Doing my job?

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.text: Opening things that should stay closed. Asking questions. Talking to that deputy.

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.text: This place works because people don't ask questions.

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.text: Stop looking. Or don't come back.
How do you respond to the owner?
